new.description: the transcript reader and the line it composes, per the section

summary: The budget line the adapter's hook hands an agent has no reader: context used, elapsed clock and tool calls off a transcript path
acceptance: a transcript path yields the budget line the section names — context against a declared window, elapsed, tool calls — and nothing at all when the latest assistant event carries no usage
tests: the budget line reports context used against the declared window from the latest assistant message's input, cache-read and cache-creation tokens
the budget line counts tool calls and elapsed clock from the transcript's own first message
a transcript whose latest assistant event carries no usage yields no budget line and says why
notes: Stateless by construction: everything comes from the transcript the provider hands the hook. The usage shape and its expiry condition are `.claude/rules/platform-facts.md`, *stream-json assistant events carry per-message usage*. Spend is not on the line — the verdict's invocation row prices it.
